story_thesis: Amazon’s advertising growth fell to 12% excluding currency effects. A nine-month comparison offers a better starting point than extrapolating a quarter distorted by Prime Day.
duplicate_checks: META LLY AAPL GOOGL already featured; AMZN not yet covered. No Nov 6 Mag 8 ledger or legacy article or branch. Open PRs 43/57 unrelated. Morning MNST AXON LYV and separate TSLA Cybertruck story checked. Index and inventories and actual Amazon coverage checked; existing AWS/cash story has one general Prime Day note but no advertising period reconciliation.
evidence_table: 10-Q revenue disaggregation: Q3 ads 19637/17703m, 9m 56689/47318m. Subtraction yields 1H 37052/29615m and growth 25.1%; quarter 10.9%, 9m 19.8%; increase 9371m. Arithmetic asserted.
Q2 release: ads excluding FX growth 26%; most large-market Prime Day in Q2 2026 versus entirely Q3 2025.
Q3 SEC release: ads excluding FX growth 12%; primarily Prime Day and other timing factors; Q4 high-teens forecast separated from actuals and currency basis left unspecified.
No standalone ad margin inferred; nine-month figures explicitly retain FX and mixed ad formats. Economic interpretation and valuation framework distinguished from reported results.
